arguments.sql_query:
WITH bronchiolitis AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (260125, 4165112)
  UNION SELECT 260125
  UNION SELECT 4165112
), acetaminophen AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 1125315
  UNION SELECT 1125315
), ped_bronch_visits AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT co.person_id, co.visit_occurrence_id
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN omop.person p ON p.person_id = co.person_id
  JOIN bronchiolitis b ON b.concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
  WHERE co.visit_occurrence_id IS NOT NULL
    AND DATEDIFF(year, DATEFROMPARTS(p.year_of_birth, 1, 1), co.condition_start_date) < 18
), acetaminophen_visits AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CAST(de.person_id AS int) AS person_id, CAST(de.visit_occurrence_id AS int) AS visit_occurrence_id
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN acetaminophen a ON a.concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  WHERE de.visit_occurrence_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS pediatric_bronchiolitis_charts,
  SUM(CASE WHEN av.visit_occurrence_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS charts_with_acetaminophen,
  CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN av.visit_occurrence_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS decimal(6,2)) AS percent_with_acetaminophen
FROM ped_bronch_visits pbv
LEFT JOIN acetaminophen_visits av
  ON av.person_id = pbv.person_id
 AND av.visit_occurrence_id = pbv.visit_occurrence_id;

For pediatric bronchiolitis charts, I selected **acetaminophen** as a supportive care medication.

Result from OMOP EHR query:

| Measure | Count |
|---|---:|
| Pediatric bronchiolitis charts | 49,539 |
| Charts with acetaminophen exposure in the same visit | 5,618 |
| Frequency | **11.34%** |

Definition used: patients <18 years old with bronchiolitis condition concepts, counted by distinct visit/chart; acetaminophen identified via RxNorm ingredient concept `1125315` and descendants.
